x: Geoff Barker was second in the 100 yards Senior and Dicky Bartlett won a straight 220 yards Senior. Ian Badiali won the 880 yards in 2min. 0.8secs. with Don Maclean in third place, while Bill Lucas beat Len Adams in the Senior mile after a good race with Fieldsend of Mitcham A.C.
Dicky Bartlett and D. Butler were second and third in the 220, and we also won the 2 miles team race, with Vern Blowfield leading the field home and scored yet another win in the 1 mile medley relay.
Alan Sexton and Dicky Bartlett also qualified for the 220 final and Alan set up a new "meet" record with a time of 22.7, beating Clay Gibbs with Dicky scoring a point for his 6th place.

Alan Sexton put up a really fine performance when winning the 440 in the fast time of 49.7 secs., and Dicky Bartlett was a good third. Ian Badiali won the 880 in 1 min. 58.6 secs., and as he was our only runner, it was just as well that he came in first.

The 300 yards 1st string event was won by Dicky Bartlett in 35.4 secs., and John Benstead won the second race in 34.5. Ian Badiali was first home in the 1st string 660 yards in 87.4 secs., and Bob Taylor recorded 86.5, to set up a new track record in the second race over this distance.
In the Senior events we saw Ron Holtum win the first 100 yards, with Ivan Mayers winning the second race, and Mayers also won his 220 yards race, with Dicky Bartlett winning the other 220 yards.

Ivan Mayers won the 100 yds., with Dicky Bartlett winning the 220, and Ian Badiali was 1st in the 880, with Ray Tooby in 3rd place. Bob Taylor was 2nd in the 1 mile, with John Burr 3rd, and George Stace ran well to win the 2 miles run in 9 mins. 58 secs.

Our team was Ron Holtum, Denis Merrett, Dicky Bartlett and Ivan Mayers, and although the latter was troubled by a foot injury, the whole team ran extremely well to beat Thames Valley H., with Cambridge H. third.

Gordon 2nd, and John Benstead won the 220, with Dicky Bartlett in 3rd place. Dicky also won the 440 yds., beating Ian Badiali, and Jim Heathfield was 3rd in the 880, with Don Maclean 2nd in the 1 mile in 4 mins. 26.9 secs.

Dicky Bartlett ran 3rd in the 220 yds., which was won by Brian Shenton, and then came the sensation of the meeting, McDonald Bailey could only finish 3rd in the 100 yds. and was beaten by Ruddy of A.P.M., and our own Ron Holtum in 10.1 secs.

The following evening, at Motspur Park, we fielded a team in a 1 mile medley relay and Ian Badiali gave us the lead over the half-mile stage, then Ian Forrester and Dicky Bartlett did the two 220's with "Jock" Cameron running the quarter, and we eventually finished 3rd.

Cameron ran a fine race to get 2nd in the 440 yds. final with Dicky Bartlett running unplaced in his heat. Bob Taylor was our "highlight" of the meeting, when he did 1 min. 55.8 secs. to finish 2nd in the 880 yds., and Ian Badiali was unlucky not to qualify in his heat.

Basil Walden was 2nd in the 100 yds., and Dicky Bartlett was 3rd in the 220. John Bromley won the 880 yds., and also finished 2nd in the 2 miles and so had a busy evening, and Bill Lucas was 4th in the latter event, with Len Bishop 2nd in the 880.

In the 440 yds. we saw Dicky Bartlett beat Bob Taylor, with Jim Heathfield in third place. The " big " event of the meeting was the Club 3 mile track championship, and the holder, Jack Brown, retained his title in 14 mins. 31.4 secs.
